name: B10-0178/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation amending Annex III to Directive (EU) 2024/1275 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the Union framework for the national calculation of life-cycle global warming potential
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report is an opinion, not a change in the law. A group of Members of the European Parliament opposes a European Commission rule on how to calculate the climate impact of buildings over their whole life. They say the Commission went beyond the powers the Parliament gave it, and that the rule adds costs and red tape for builders, local authorities and households. They ask the Commission to withdraw it and come back with a narrower version.

**Key points**

- The Parliament formally objects, so the Commission's rule on building climate calculations cannot come into force.
- It affects builders, small firms, local authorities and households facing higher construction and housing costs.
- The Commission is asked to send a new, narrower rule by the third quarter of 2026.
